title: The Summer Hikaru Died Manga to End in 2 Chapters
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Mokumokuren 's The Summer Hikaru Died ( Hikaru ga Shinda Natsu ) manga announced on Tuesday that the manga will end in two chapters. The manga's chapter 50 is scheduled to publish on October 13, and chapter 51 is scheduled to publish on October 20.
author: ANN

title: Nippon Sangoku Anime Gets Sequel
content: Twin Engine announced on Thursday that production on a sequel to Nippon Sangoku The Three Nations of the Crimson Sun , the television anime of Ikka Matsuki 's Nippon Sangoku manga, has been green-lit.
author: ANN

title: NIPPON SANGOKU Sequel Anime Announced
content: NIPPON SANGOKU sequel anime has been officially announced two months after the first season’s finale released on June 21. Studio Kafka was in charge of the animation, while the anime was co-produced with Amazon MGM Studios and is available for streaming on Prime Video.
author: Anime Corner

title: Oedo Fire Slayer Manga Goes on Hiatus Due to Artist's Illness
content: This year's 40th issue of Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine announced on Thursday that Shinobu Seguchi 's Oedo Fire Slayer ( Hikuidori Ushūboro Tobigumi ) manga adaptation of Shōgo Imamura 's Hikuidori historical novel does not appear in the issue and will go on hiatus at least until the magazine's next…
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Please Save My Earth Series' Teaser Shows Glimpse of Mokuren
content: Amazon Prime Video posted an early teaser trailer for the live-action series of Saki Hiwatari 's Please Save My Earth manga on Thursday. The teaser offers a partial glimpse of Alice Hirose ( Bubble , live-action Silver Spoon , HYOUKA ) as Mokuren.
author: ANN

title: 10 Best Anime to Binge on Crunchyroll in September 2026
content: Now that we’re already in September, the Fall 2026 anime season is only a month away. It will be the final quarter of the year, so fans can expect some of the most exciting new releases and sequels. Not only that, but many Summer 2026 series are also expected to reach their conclusion by the end of this month.
author: ComicBook

title: Honey Lemon Soda Creator Mayu Murata Draws 1-Shot
content: The October issue of Shueisha 's Ribon magazine announced on Thursday Mayu Murata will draw a one-shot manga adaptation of musical artist tuki. 's new song "Bubble" in the next issue on October 2.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Anime's New Trailer Unveils October 11 Debut, Theme Songs
content: Toei revealed on Wednesday the October 11 premiere for the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus television anime series along with a new "Super Surge" trailer, visual, and the theme song artists. The trailer previews the ending theme song "Kan Peki No Peki" by VK Blanka and the opening theme song "ONOGAMI" by MEGATERA･ZERO.
author: ANN

title: Two Years Ago, One Piece Entered Its Final Phase With Its Biggest Arc Ever
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the One Piece manga! Although One Piece entered its Final Saga in the Egghead Arc, the story truly begins to head towards its ending in the ongoing Elbaph Arc.
author: ComicBook

title: Dandadan Studio’s Biggest Reboot Already Has a Finale Date
content: Science SARU is one of the most renowned animation studios in Japan, known for several acclaimed shows and films with unique animation and exceptional storytelling. Its flagship series, Dandadan , debuted in 2024 and made the studio popular around the globe after it went viral.
